purpose: Clean Ubuntu VPS staging replica of the current Morphiume application and authoritative runtime data; OVF/OVA is canceled

sourceObservation.meaning: Fresh observed source metadata; target requirements are recommendations, not measurements of a new VPS

host.kernelPolicy: Supported provider Ubuntu kernel, current security updates and completed required reboot before migration
host.swap: Optional 2-4 GiB safety margin; not a substitute for RAM or measured capacity
host.timeSynchronization: Required; UTC storage, application business timezone Asia/Tehran
host.offsiteBackup: Separate versioned encrypted destination and independently held age recovery identity required

aptVersionPolicy: Use official signed Noble repositories; pin all five Docker package versions in a private target manifest and record dpkg-query package versions. Ubuntu security patch versions are captured at target preparation, not invented in Git.

applicationRelease.selectionStatus: Select only after the requested dependency upgrade passes full source and packaged-image acceptance
applicationRelease.runtimeSource: The accepted Dockerfile and bundled standalone Node/worker/CLI image; use package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml at that exact source commit

historicalBeforeUpgrade.meaning: Historical reference only; never substitute these values for the newly accepted upgrade

ingress.ssh: Actual approved SSH port, restricted admin source CIDR
ingress.httpHttps: Reverse proxy only, explicit target preview CIDR/VPN until public launch

mustTest: Actual external IPv6 or verified absence of AAAA/IPv6 route
network.previewAuthority: Existing authless-admin capability is hard-coded to the source origin. Do not activate it on a new public origin; target login/MFA remains normal unless a separately reviewed restricted-preview implementation is accepted.

storage.transfer: Encrypted logical database dump, exact bounded media tree, protected service config and role/ACL metadata; accepted immutable application image; no live PGDATA copy
storage.spaceRule: Size from fresh allocated bytes: OS/Docker + current PG cluster growth + media + accepted/fallback image archives/layers + retained encrypted backups + largest isolated restore working set + >=25% free headroom. Include optional historical archives separately.
